sampling_rate.source: the files' timestamps (0.02 s steps in 12 of 118 sessions: 2 downloaded, 10 read by byte range); no text read states the rate

position_span.source: the 1 x 1 meter enclosure of the session_description in the files (DANDI's metadata for all 118 assets carries the same text; 12 files opened) and of the authors' readme (readme_sargolini2006.txt, NIRD doi:10.11582/2014.00003); the largest span of the tracked positions must lie within 20% of the 100 cm side

speed_limit.source: Iriarte-Díaz 2002, J. Exp. Biol. 205:2897-2908, Table 1: Rattus runs at most 13.78 body lengths/s at a 0.190 m body length, 2.62 m/s (from Garland 1983 and Nowak 1999); times 1.5 because the tracked point is a head-mounted LED, which swings faster than the body, and no source read states head speed

sessions.verification: Checked by hand on 2026-11-03 against the file, the authors' readme and pynapple's DANDI tutorial, which loads this file. Units: 8 (t1c1, t2c1, t2c3, t3c1, t3c2, t3c3, t3c4, t4c1, every histology 'MEC LII'). The tutorial prints the same 8 units, whose rates times its 599.896 s span give this file's 1759 and 901 spikes for units 0 and 1; that is a second reader of the same file, not an independent source. Time: 30000 samples of LED1 at 0.02 s (50 Hz), 0 to 599.98 s, the 10-minute session the readme describes; spikes from 0.079 to 599.976 s, inside the tracking. Space: x from -50 to 50 cm and y from -49.36 to 49.36 cm. That these lie inside the 1 x 1 m enclosure the readme and the file's session_description state holds by construction, since the coordinates are centred and scaled to the box; what it still checks independently is the cm conversion (the file's unit 'meters' with conversion 0.01, not mm or pixels). The paper's Methods were not available to read, so no number here comes from it.

Checked by hand by the real-data survey, and again on 2026-11-03, against the file, the authors' readme and pynapple's tutorial_null_distributions, which prints a six-unit table for this file. Units: 6 (t1c2, t3c2, t3c3, t4c1, t4c2, t4c3, every histology 'MEC LIII'). Time: 30000 samples of LED1 at 0.02 s (50 Hz), 0 to 599.98 s; spikes from 0.36 to 599.90 s. Space: x from -49.02 to 49.02 cm and y from -50 to 50 cm, inside the stated 1 x 1 m enclosure by construction (the coordinates are centred and scaled to the box), which still checks the cm conversion. The unit table is a second reader (pynapple) of the same file, not an independent source.
